origin.description: Median of the observations in a zoo series.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing observations are removed before the median is taken. If FALSE, any missing observation makes the result missing.

origin.details: The median is the median of the core data. An even count averages the two central order statistics. With na.rm TRUE, the series 1, NA, 3 has median 2.

translation.description: Median of the observations in a zoo series.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, missing observations are removed before the median is taken. If False, any missing observation makes the result missing.

translation.details: The median is the median of the values. An even count averages the two central order statistics. With na_rm True, the series 1, NA, 3 has median 2.
translation.example:
import math
import sys

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/zoo")
from zoo.zoo_class import aggregate_zoo, ifelse_zoo, is_zoo, median_zoo, quantile_zoo, rev_zoo, xtfrm_zoo, zoo


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, (bool, np.bool_)):
        print("TRUE" if value else "FALSE")
        return
    if is_zoo(value):
        show(value.data)
        show(value.index)
        return
    array = np.asarray(value, dtype=float).ravel(order="F")
    print(" ".join("NA" if math.isnan(float(item)) else format(float(item), ".16g") for item in array))

show(median_zoo(zoo([1, float('nan'), 3], [1, 2, 3]), na_rm=True))
